youtube.title: The Study Locked From the Inside: Solve the Trick
youtube.description:
A crime investigation story you can solve: a study locked from the inside, the key on the desk, and three clues in plain view.

A publisher's study is locked, the only key lies on his desk, and three people each have an alibi. Kiri, a quiet twelve-year-old, shows how a simple thread-and-wax trick fooled everyone, and why a stopped watch told the wrong time. Pause at the clues and guess before he explains the locked-room trick step by step.
